parsed.summary: After a full functional review, the design files match the intended reference design described in the spec: every interface net, pin assignment, and passive value is equivalent. The only differences are reference designators and net names (e.g. the MCU is U1 here vs U2 in the spec, the NFC IC U4 vs U3, the display U2 vs U4, and auto-generated NETxxxx names), which are annotations and do not change board behaviour. All power/ground connections, I2C buses (NFC on PB8/PB9, display on PB13/PB14 with BS=010 strapping and D0=SCL/D1+D2=SDA), pull-ups (10k), TSC network (PB5 via 1k to electrode, PB7 via 22n sampling cap), NRST pull-up, SSD1306 charge-pump network (1uF flying caps, 4.7uF VCOMH, 390k IREF, 2.2uF VCC), decoupling set (2x4.7uF, 2x1uF, 6x100nF) and antenna tuning cap ('??' documented limitation) all agree with the specification. No functional anomaly found.
